    GraphCanvasModel(GraphCanvasModel other)
    Deep-copies another canvas: a fully independent net, frames whose membership is translated onto the new net's own element instances, and fusions rebuilt the same way — nothing here is shared with other, so mutating the copy (running a simulation on it, editing it) can never reach back into other or vice versa.
